Our little moments

A letter from my heart

A few things I want you to know, Shamika.

Shamika, I want you to know how genuinely special you are to me. You make me smile in ways you probably don't even realise. I love your presence, your little expressions, our conversations, and all the simple moments that become beautiful just because you're in them.

Thank you for being you. I don't need every moment with you to be perfect or cinematic. Even the ordinary moments feel worth keeping when they're shared with you.

I love you, and I hope I make you feel as valued, respected, and appreciated as you deserve to feel. ❤️

With all my love,
Yours ♡

My promises to you

Not just pretty words. Promises I want to show through my actions, every day.

♡I promise to respect you, your choices, your dreams, and your individuality.
♡I promise to listen and communicate honestly, even when a conversation is difficult.
♡I promise to support your goals and celebrate your wins like they're my own.
♡I promise not to take your trust or your love for granted.
♡I promise to keep choosing us, while giving each other space to grow.
♡I won't claim to be perfect, but I will keep learning and putting effort into our relationship.

To our future ✨

♡

I don't know every detail of what the future holds, but I know what I hope for: more laughter, more adventures, late-night talks, silly pictures, shared dreams, and a life where we keep supporting each other.

Here's to growing together without holding each other back, comforting each other after hard days, celebrating every little victory, and making memories we'll smile about years from now.

Whatever comes our way, I hope we always remember that we're on the same team. One honest day at a time. 🌻

You and me, writing our story together.
